class.name: ParticipantViewport
class.brief_description: Tiles several [ParticipantWindow] nodes into the enclosing viewport, one per local participant.
class.description: Several participants running in one process each hold their own [ParticipantWindow], and this node is what puts all of them on one screen. Registered slots partition the enclosing viewport into the squarest grid that holds them, re-tiled whenever a slot is added, removed, or the enclosing viewport resizes. Mouse and keyboard follow native window focus, which the engine already routes, so this node does not touch them. Joypads have no focus, so they are routed by device id: [method assign_device] binds one device to one slot and every joypad event from that device is delivered there and marked handled. [codeblock] var tiler := ParticipantViewport.new() add_child(tiler) for seat in seats: tiler.add_slot(seat.window) tiler.assign_device(seat.device_id, seat.window) [/codeblock] A slot must be registered before it can take a device, because a binding to an unplaced window would swallow that player's input into something nothing is drawing. Removing a slot drops its device bindings with it, so a device whose window left routes nowhere rather than somewhere invisible. Registration is not parenthood: this node tiles the windows it is given and never reparents or frees them, so a slot may live anywhere in the tree and outlive the tiling.

method.name: add_slot
method.description: Registers [param slot] for tiling, makes it visible and re-tiles every slot. Answers [param slot] so a caller can build and place in one expression, or [code]null[/code] when handed nothing. Registering a slot twice is inert.

method.name: assign_device
method.description: Routes every joypad event carrying [param device_id] into [param slot]. Refused, with an error, when [param slot] is not registered here, because a binding this node cannot tile would drop that player's input where nobody can see it. One device binds to one slot; binding it again replaces the first.

method.name: device_slot
method.description: The slot [param device_id] is routed to, or [code]null[/code] when the device is unbound or its slot has since been removed or freed.

method.name: get_slots
method.description: The registered slots, in tiling order, skipping any that have been freed. Position in this array is position in the grid: index zero is the top left cell and the row fills left to right.

method.name: has_slot
method.description: Whether [param slot] is registered for tiling here. [code]false[/code] for [code]null[/code] and for a window this node has never been given.

method.name: remove_slot
method.description: Unregisters [param slot], hides it, drops every device bound to it and re-tiles the rest. Does not free it. Removing a slot that was never registered is inert.

members.member: Whether the enclosing viewport draws child [Window] nodes inside itself rather than as real OS windows. On by default, because a tiling of native windows is a tiling the window manager gets a vote on. Turn it off to give each participant a real window to move around.
